---

Two things worth knowing before you spend time on this, because they change who can fix it:

**This project does not collect or verify any of these figures.** They come from what
providers reported to California and California reported to the U.S. Department of Labor.
Where the error is this project's — a wrong join, a misread column, a number rendered in the
wrong place — it gets fixed here, and quickly. Where the underlying public record is wrong,
the correction has to go through the body that published it, and this issue is a reasonable
place to record that it is wrong in the meantime.

**A blank is not a bug.** "Not reported" means the provider reported nothing or the figure
was withheld to protect the privacy of a small group. Roughly a third of California's
programs report nothing at all. If a blank should be a number, say so and we will look — but
blanks are frequently correct, and rendering them as zero is the failure this site exists to
avoid.
